fomod.Name: Jarl Ulfric Armor Replacer
fomod.Author: NordwarUA (assets and records), ApocryphaRealm (extraction)
fomod.Description: Ulfric Stormcloak's armour from NordwarUA's Guards Armor Replacer, on its own - his cuirass, gauntlets, boots and helmet, and the two outfits that put them on him. Nothing else from that mod is included. Outfit records only; Ulfric's NPC records are left untouched, so this does not conflict with face, AI or appearance mods.
